metadata.question: Did New York experience an air temperature difference of at least 24 degrees Celcius between January 29 and February 5, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land Hourly (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) primary, fallback to ERA5 Hourly (ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY) if needed. Dates: 2019-01-29 and 2019-02-05. Location: NYC point buffered 30 km.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for reanalysis. Use full coverage. Validate with pixel counts in region reduction.
3. Logic: Check collection size per date; if 0 for both datasets -> C1. After reduction, if pixel count is 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [-100, 80] C -> C3. Otherwise compute absolute difference; >= 24C -> A else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); 

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      eeObject.getInfo(resolve, reject);
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const nycPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]);
    const region = nycPoint.buffer(30000).bounds(); // ~30 km buffer
    const dates = ['2019-01-29', '2019-02-05'];

    const datasets = [
      { id: 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY', band: 'temperature_2m', name: 'ERA5-Land' },
      { id: 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY', band: 'temperature_2m', name: 'ERA5' }
    ];

    async function dailyMeanC(dateStr) {
      for (const ds of datasets) {
        const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
        const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
        let col = ee.ImageCollection(ds.id).filterDate(start, end).select(ds.band);
        const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size && size > 0) {
          const img = col.mean(); // mean over the 24 hours
          const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true });
          const stats = await getInfoAsync(
            img.reduceRegion({
              reducer: reducer,
              geometry: region,
              scale: 10000,
              maxPixels: 1e9
            })
          );
          const meanK = stats ? stats[ds.band + '_mean'] : null;
          const pixCount = stats ? stats[ds.band + '_count'] : 0;

          if (!stats || meanK === null || meanK === undefined || Number.isNaN(meanK)) {
            return { ok: false, code: 'C3', msg: `Calc failed for ${dateStr} (${ds.name}).` };
          }
          if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
            return { ok: false, code: 'C2', msg: `No valid pixels for ${dateStr} (${ds.name}).` };
          }
          const meanC = meanK - 273.15;
          if (!(meanC > -100 && meanC < 80)) {
            return { ok: false, code: 'C3', msg: `Invalid temperature for ${dateStr}: ${meanC}` };
          }
          return { ok: true, date: dateStr, src: ds.name, images: size, meanC: meanC, pixels: pixCount };
        }
      }
      return { ok: false, code: 'C1', msg: `No images for ${dateStr} in both datasets.` };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks
    console.log('Region: NYC (30 km buffer around 40.7128,-74.0060)');
    const r1 = await dailyMeanC(dates[0]);
    const r2 = await dailyMeanC(dates[1]);

    // Handle errors or empty cases
    if (!r1.ok) {
      console.log(`${dates[0]}: ${r1.msg}`);
      console.log('C1' === r1.code ? 'C1' : r1.code);
      return;
    }
    if (!r2.ok) {
      console.log(`${dates[1]}: ${r2.msg}`);
      console.log('C1' === r2.code ? 'C1' : r2.code);
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Evidence
    const fmt = (x) => (Math.round(x * 100) / 100).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`${r1.date}: src=${r1.src}, images=${r1.images}, meanC=${fmt(r1.meanC)}, pixels=${r1.pixels}`);
    console.log(`${r2.date}: src=${r2.src}, images=${r2.images}, meanC=${fmt(r2.meanC)}, pixels=${r2.pixels}`);

    // 4. Calculation
    const diff = Math.abs(r2.meanC - r1.meanC);
    console.log(`Abs difference (C): ${fmt(diff)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (Number.isNaN(diff) || diff === null || diff === undefined) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (diff >= 24.0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
